contentHtml:
Dell Repairs Stretton

Looking for a combination of high quality and affordable repairs and services for your Dell computer? Computer Repairs Stretton offers the best services in all of Brisbane!

We pride ourselves in providing the expert repair services for any Dell desktop computer and laptop. Our Dell-trained experts have a wide range of experience in identifying and troubleshooting nearly every type of hardware and software issue. Why buy a new Dell laptop when we can fix or upgrade your current system with just a fraction of the cost of purchasing a new one? At Computer Repairs Stretton, you can be confident that your computer repair problems are being resolved by our professionals. There is no hardware, software and system issue that are too complex.

Our Dell computer repairs Stretton offers

Dell DC jack repair, Does your laptop refuse to run when it’s plugged in but works just fine with the battery? Has your DC jack starts feeling loose? Consider having your DC jack checked and repaired.

Dell motherboard repair, Your computer’s motherboard serves as its backbone. Having your motherboard repaired is often cheaper than having it replaced. Give us a call for the best Dell computer repairs in Brisbane!

Dell LCD repair and replacement, Is your LCD screen broken? You can’t see anything on your screen? Whether your Dell LCD monitor is missing lines or even blocks of information, we at Computer Repairs Stretton can restore its performance.

Dell back-light repair and replacement, Our expert technicians at Computer Repairs Stretton can restore your LCD screen to its original brightness and contrast.

Dell laptop keyboard repair and replacement, Accidentally spilled coffee or tea on your keyboard? Unable to use some keys? It might be time for your keyboard to be replaced. Computer Repairs Stretton can have your keyboard replaced with only genuine Dell parts so you can be confident for 100% compatibility and quality of every Dell laptop we repair.

Dell touch-pad replacement, Touch-pad won’t work? Cursor is skipping or hangs randomly? Give us a call and we will see whether it can be repaired or if it needs a brand new replacement.

Dell inverter repair, Is your Dell LCD displaying flickering or faint images? Just give us a call and we will make sure your Dell laptop inverter gets repaired or replaced. We offer nothing but the best Dell computer repairs in Brisbane!

Your Dell computer requires not only the hardware attention; Computer Repairs Stretton also covers the software repairs for you. Call us at 0477 319 160 and have an expert consultation with our professionals about your Dell repair needs.

Dell virus and spyware removal , Is your Dell laptop infected by a virus? Our dedicated virus removal service guarantees that your computer will be 100% cleaned from all kinds of harmful programs and malicious software.

Dell desktop and laptop upgrades, We offer plenty of cost-effective options for your system upgrade needs.

  • Computer Reformatting
  • Performance Speedup
  • Operating System Installation
  • Laptop Upgrades
  • Computer Tune-up
  • PC Upgrades
  • Optimization
  • Hardware Installation

Dell internet and network setup , Our experts can help you in setting up your network connection on your Dell computers including internet connectivity and file sharing whether you preferred to be wired or wireless.

Dell data and file recovery, Can’t log in on your computer because you have forgotten your password? Computer Repairs Stretton has just the perfect data and file recovery for you.

Other Dell hardware repairs

  • Dell overheating repair
  • Dell laptop not turning on
  • Dell laptop LCD screen is very dim or dark
  • Display only visible on external monitor but not visible on laptop LCD screen
  • Dell laptop LCD screen not turning on
  • Dell laptop LCD screen is cracked
  • Dell laptop GPU or graphics card problem and distorted display
  • Dell laptop power supply repairs
  • Dell loose or broken hinge replacement
  • LED and CCFL bulb replacement
  • Dell laptop optical drive upgrade and replacement (DVD-RW, DVD burners)
  • Dell AC/DC power jack repairs
  • Dell memory upgrades
  • Replacement of dell broken or cracked plastic parts (LCD cover and base cover)
  • Dell liquid spill repairs (cola, water, coffee, tea, wine, etc.)
  • Dell internal dust and particles cleaning
  • Dell component level motherboard repairs

Other Dell software repairs

  • Dell laptop data and file backup services
  • Dell laptop operating system upgrades
  • Transfer of data to new hard drive or new Dell laptop
  • Solutions for slow working dell laptops
  • Solutions and repairs for Blue Screen of Deaths (BSODs) and freezing symptoms
  • Dell laptop driver installation

Custom built Dell computer, Nothing beats having your very own computer built just for you! All you need to do is give us the right specifications and we will have a custom Dell computer built for you in no time.

Here’s how you can avail our services

Our workshop services, Computer Repairs Stretton has a large inventory of genuine Dell laptop replacement parts that will guarantee to save your precious time and money. Just visit our workshop anytime, 7 days a week from 7am up to 10pm and even on holidays.

Onsite services, Not so sure about bringing your computer to us? You don’t have to! Our experts can bring their services to your home or residence. Just give us a call at 0477 319 160 and have our expert technician’s onsite visit scheduled for you, absolutely free of call out fees and travel costs.

Remote services, Did you know that almost all software and network repair service can actually be done remotely? It means that all you need to do is download a special software and we will be able to access your computer with your permission and fix your computer problem with no additional charges!
